name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A tooltip component built on Radix UI with dark/light variants, multiple sizes, and arrow indicator. Uses namespace exports: Tooltip.Root, Tooltip.Trigger, Tooltip.Content.

docs.lead: A tooltip component with dark/light variants, multiple sizes, positioned arrow, and rich HTML content support.
docs.usage:
import * as Tooltip from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

<Tooltip.Root>
  <Tooltip.Trigger>Hover me</Tooltip.Trigger>
  <Tooltip.Content>Tooltip content.</Tooltip.Content>
</Tooltip.Root>

examples.title: Light
examples.description: Light variant tooltip with white background and border.

examples.title: Size
examples.description: Tooltips in medium, small (default), and xsmall sizes.

examples.title: Position
examples.description: Tooltips positioned on all four sides: left, top, bottom, right.

api.name: Tooltip.Root
api.description: Wraps the trigger and content. Passes through Radix Tooltip.Root props.

api.name: Tooltip.Trigger
api.description: The element that triggers the tooltip on hover/focus.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Tooltip.Content
api.description: The tooltip popup content with arrow.

props.name: side
props.description: The preferred side to position the tooltip

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger

api.description: Wraps your app to provide shared tooltip delay and skip settings.
